title_yt: The GTA 6 sick day costs more than 3 games #Shorts
title_fb: The GTA 6 sick day costs more than three games
hook: If you call in sick for G T A six, that free day costs three games.
open_loop: Hook promises the free day costs 'three games'. The coins drain on the couch; the exact price ($247 vs $79.99 boxes) is revealed in the last ~8 s.
payoff: Pay stub -$247 next to three generic $79.99 game boxes. Playing after work costs $0 extra.

lines.text: If you call in sick for GTA 6, that free day costs three games.
lines.say: If you call in sick for G T A six, that free day costs three games.
lines.visual: Benny in office shirt and tie at a desk, phone to ear, fake cough with fist. Stranger (boss, hooded) behind him, arms crossed, suspicious. Headline 'GTA 6 SICK DAY'. Cough bubble 'cough cough'. Scene change on 'free day' to a big gold '$0?' stamp, then on 'three games' to three question-mark boxes.
Close-up: Benny coughs, shocked-then-smug. Boss stranger squints and shrugs 'okay'. Benny throws the tie, hoodie on.

lines.text: Now you are on the couch while your pay drains.
lines.visual: Benny in hoodie on a couch with a plain controller-shaped silhouette and snacks. Coin pile under his feet; coins slide away. Wall clock ticks hour by hour. Badge 'HOUR 3'.

lines.text: At average pay, an unpaid day costs about $247.
lines.say: At average pay, an unpaid day costs about two hundred fifty dollars.
lines.visual: Pay stub slides in with counter counting down to -$247. Small badge 'AVG US FULL-TIME, 40 H WEEK, IF UNPAID'. Benny's grin freezes.
Three plain gray generic game boxes (no art, no logo) stack up with pop sfx, each tagged '$79.99'. Benny shocked, snap-zoom on 'three'.

lines.text: Play after work, and it costs nothing extra.
lines.visual: Benny back at 5 pm, hoodie, happy on couch at night, coins intact. Badge '$0 EXTRA'. Confetti small.

lines.text: Sick day, or play after work? Comment A or B.
lines.visual: Split frame: Benny flu-face on the left 'A: SICK DAY', Benny smug at night on the right 'B: AFTER WORK'. Benny points at the viewer.
lines.on_screen: A: SICK DAY / B: AFTER WORK

facts_used.claim: US median usual weekly earnings of full-time workers Q1 2026 = $1,235; full time = 35+ h/week.
GTA 6 Standard Edition price $79.99; release Nov 19, 2026.
'GTA Flu' = launch-week meme of faking sick days (no stats used).

upload.title: The GTA 6 sick day costs more than 3 games #Shorts
upload.description:
Think a fake sick day is free? Do the math first.
Sick day, or play after work? Comment A or B.
If the day is unpaid, the average US full-time worker (40 hours a week) loses about $247. A new game costs $79.99, so that is three games.
Not financial advice. Many jobs offer paid sick leave. Pay data: US Bureau of Labor Statistics.
